scope: Combined PDB (A-P2-DRAFT) + Osiris Rev A power-path simulation

engine.why_not_pspice: C:/Cadence/OrCADX_25.1/tools/bin/pspice.exe launches the OrCAD X Standard GUI and blocks; verified by process inspection (MainWindowTitle 'OrCAD X Standard', no .out produced, exit without writing results). No license daemon configured and no batch path available. LTspice was selected by the user after this was demonstrated.
engine.dialect_warning: Decks use LTspice-only constructs (B-sources, tanh/limit/if, Rser= on caps, .step param, table()). They will NOT run in PSpice without translation.

models.pin_order: VIN UV OV RETRY GND SHDN FAULT VOUT SENSE GATE
1 OUT, 2 ADJ, 3 NC, 4 GND, 5 SHDN, 6 NC, 7 NC, 8 IN
models.limits: Datasheet operating range is Vin >= 3 V. Behaviour at or below 0 V input (reverse-battery case) is OUTSIDE the model's valid range and produced a non-physical -1.31 V output; that number is a model artifact and must not be reported as a circuit finding.

models.provenance: DATASHEET-FITTED VDMOS, built here. No Infineon SPICE model was available.
models.limits: Square-law VDMOS cannot match RDS(on)=1.3 mohm and gfs=56 S simultaneously; RDS(on) was held, so gm is roughly 2x high and the Miller plateau sits ~0.3 V low. Inrush is therefore mildly optimistic. NO SOA, avalanche, or thermal validity. The 178.7 A short-circuit peak is NOT an SOA demonstration.
BV 28.1 V and Rdyn 1.4 ohm from VBR/VC datasheet points; Cjo estimated, not measured.

THE FUSE DOES NOT OPEN. Cold resistance only; real resistance rises steeply when heating, so modelled drop and let-through are optimistic. The 17 A^2s figure is PRE-ARCING (melting) I2t, NOT total clearing I2t. Reaching it indicates melting energy delivered, not that the fuse cleared. Interrupt rating is 1000 A, not 3000 A.
Supply draw and input impedance only. NO ADC, NO I2C, NO register map, NO alert logic. Says nothing about measurement accuracy or alert timing.
No propagation delay, no output slew shaping.

models.provenance: Pre-existing engineering surrogate in this repo, self-labelled 'not a TI model'
models.limits: SR=28100 V/s, TD=100us, RON=0.0284 ohm are SURROGATE DEFAULTS, not datasheet values. TI's real LM73100_TRANS.lib is PSpice-encrypted and unreadable here, and would not load in LTspice anyway. No thermal model, no fast-trip, no current limit. The ~3.4 A inrush figure that follows from SR rests on an unverified slew rate.

models.provenance: Behavioural averaged buck written here. No AP64501 model or datasheet exists in this tree.
models.limits: Captures constant-power input characteristic, soft-start, UVLO and current limit. Does NOT model switching ripple, loop stability or phase margin, the COMP networks (R4/C14, R9/C28), inductor saturation, efficiency-vs-load (single constant EFF=0.85), or thermals. Switching frequency (570 kHz in calculate_power.py) is UNVERIFIED and unused by this model.
Regulation, dropout and pass-through current only. Only U12 (+3V3_AON) is instantiated as a node; the rest are folded into aggregate rail loads.

models.device: All Osiris digital consumers (Jetson, STM32H743, radios, USB hub, Ethernet bridge)
models.limits: NO per-device current figure exists in any source in this tree. Only planning ceilings (2.5 A on +5V0, 2.0 A on +3V3, 7 W Jetson) exist, all self-labelled assumptions in requirements-20260910.md and calculate_power.py. The split between +5V0 and +5V0_PROT (60/40) is an assumption with NO source. Firmware, I2C/SPI/USB/Ethernet/CAN/radio behaviour and the U11 sequencer program are not simulated; TSEQ=50 ms is an assumed boot delay.

known_model_bugs_found_and_fixed.bug: DIGILOAD rail-collapse guard was applied to the pre-ramp value, so the 25 ms ramp kept sinking ~0.46 A from a dead rail and drove +5V0_PROT to -349 V, which then made the U4 pass element attempt ~12 kA.
known_model_bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Guard now multiplies the final drawn current.
known_model_bugs_found_and_fixed.found_by: Recovery measurement returning a physically impossible negative voltage.

known_model_bugs_found_and_fixed.bug: Hard if()/> comparators in BGO, BSEQ, BEN3/BEN5 chattered when rails decayed through threshold, collapsing the timestep to ~1e-15 and hanging the OV case (5817 tolerance warnings).
known_model_bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Smoothed with tanh. Transition widths are NUMERICAL softening, not modelled hysteresis.

measurement_artifacts_encountered: `.meas INTEG ABS(ddt(...))` edge-counting returned 0 while the circuit was demonstrably oscillating. Superseded by direct min/max/avg over disjoint time windows. Do not trust ddt-based edge counts in these decks.
A 1.5 s fault window was too short to distinguish 'does not recover' from 'has not recovered yet'; the LTC4368 retry alone is ~545 ms. Extended to 3 s.
not_modelled: Fuse opening, arcing, clearing time, interrupt capability
Buck switching ripple and control-loop stability
All digital/firmware behaviour on both boards
PCB parasitics, trace resistance/inductance, thermal coupling
Component tolerance corners (single nominal values used throughout except where swept)
Osiris J24/J25 Module Hub pins 14/16/18/20, which tap raw VIN and allow unbudgeted external draw
